visual_review.identity: Rust/red-brown scorched soil with gray-brown stone groups and burnt orange dry tufts; original warm material distinction retained without lava, emissive fissures, fire or symbols.
visual_review.palette_caveat: Ground is noticeably more orange/red and more saturated than the original restrained brown swatch. Read-only color metrics record the shift for parent review.
visual_review.density_caveat: Around 25-35 accent groups rather than 12-18; main stones and tufts are larger than 3-8-unit guidance at 256 period. Broad soil patches contain residual fine low-contrast mottling despite a clean-plane prompt.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Main accent groups commonly read about 10-24 world units at the proposed 256 period. These remain material marks, not new colliders or standing objects.
visual_review.native_acceptance: 1254 fully opaque native candidate, original tone 1 active on c01-14. No scene binding or natural seamlessness claim.
